response.overview: A pizza shop owner, who is going through a bad custody agreement with his ex wife, looses his composure and snaps. A  situation escalates with a young kid and he ends up slapping him on the face .The kid, is the son of an angry, wealthy and well connected man, who lives in the same building. What happens after, takes us on a journey under the skin of both men.
response.tagline: One slip, One slap and everything spirals!
response.title: الدليڤري يافندم
